description: This file defines the LookupRef class, which provides deprecated static methods for various lookup and reference functions similar to Excel functions. It acts as a facade for more specific classes, enabling features like CELL_ADDRESS, COLUMN, ROW, HYPERLINK, INDIRECT, OFFSET, CHOOSE, MATCH, INDEX, TRANSPOSE, VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, LOOKUP, and FORMULATEXT, with deprecation notices prompting to use newer class methods.

classes.name: LookupRef
classes.description: A deprecated utility class providing static methods for lookup and reference functions. It serves as a facade directing calls to more current classes and methods, with deprecation warnings indicating the preferred updates to newer class methods.

methods.name: cellAddress
methods.description: Creates a cell address string given row and column numbers, delegating to Address::cell.

methods.name: COLUMN
methods.description: Returns the column number for a given cell reference or range, delegating to RowColumnInformation::COLUMN.

methods.name: COLUMNS
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in a range, delegating to RowColumnInformation::COLUMNS.

methods.name: ROW
methods.description: Returns the row number for a given cell reference or range, delegating to RowColumnInformation::ROW.

methods.name: ROWS
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a range, delegating to RowColumnInformation::ROWS.

methods.name: HYPERLINK
methods.description: Creates a hyperlink in a cell, delegating to LookupRef\Hyperlink::set.

methods.name: INDIRECT
methods.description: Returns a cell or range reference specified by a text string, delegating to Indirect::INDIRECT.

methods.name: OFFSET
methods.description: Returns a reference offset from a starting cell or range, delegating to Offset::OFFSET.

methods.name: CHOOSE
methods.description: Selects a value from a list based on an index, delegating to LookupRef\Selection::choose.

methods.name: MATCH
methods.description: Searches for a value in a range, delegating to LookupRef\ExcelMatch::MATCH.

methods.name: INDEX
methods.description: Returns a value or range at a given row and column from a matrix, delegating to LookupRef\Matrix::index.

methods.name: TRANSPOSE
methods.description: Transposes a matrix, delegating to LookupRef\Matrix::transpose.

methods.name: VLOOKUP
methods.description: Performs vertical lookup, delegating to VLookup::lookup.

methods.name: HLOOKUP
methods.description: Performs horizontal lookup, delegating to HLookup::lookup.

methods.name: LOOKUP
methods.description: Performs general lookup, delegating to Lookup::lookup.

methods.name: FORMULATEXT
methods.description: Gets the formula text of a cell, delegating to LookupRef\Formula::text.
